name: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Grind through brutal data-labeling all-nighters to become an AI genius who eventually works two days a week for a fortune — or claw your way to the very top of the company and start making decisions the rest of Sulani will regret.

branches.name: Foundations in Machine Learning
branches.description: The unglamorous, exhausting climb every AI genius has to survive before the money starts rolling in.

levels.title: Data Labeling Intern
levels.description: You spend brutally long days clicking checkboxes to teach a computer what a cat looks like.
levels.promotion_message: You've been hired! Welcome to the bottom of the machine learning food chain.

levels.title: Junior Data Wrangler
levels.description: You clean messy datasets until your eyes bleed, all for the promise of a better title someday.
levels.promotion_message: Your code finally stopped crashing. You're a Junior Data Wrangler now.

levels.title: ML Engineer I
levels.description: You build your first real models while surviving on energy drinks and stubbornness.
levels.promotion_message: You've earned the title ML Engineer I. The grind is paying off, slowly.

levels.title: Model Trainer
levels.description: You train neural networks that occasionally do exactly what you want, which feels like magic.
levels.promotion_message: Your models are finally converging. You're a Model Trainer now.

levels.title: Senior ML Engineer
levels.description: You lead small projects and mentor interns who remind you painfully of yourself two years ago.
levels.promotion_message: Senior ML Engineer! You're finally sleeping more than five hours a night.

levels.title: Lead ML Architect
levels.description: You design entire systems from scratch, and executives are starting to notice your name.
levels.promotion_message: You're now Lead ML Architect. Two very different paths lie ahead of you now.

branches.name: Machine Learning Engineer Track
branches.description: Keep building the algorithms yourself, becoming a legend whose genius eventually buys total freedom.

levels.title: Principal ML Scientist
levels.description: You publish research that makes rival companies panic and recruiters slide into your inbox.
levels.promotion_message: Principal ML Scientist! The industry actually reads your papers now.

levels.title: Distinguished AI Researcher
levels.description: You architect breakthrough systems that quietly reshape the tech world while you work shorter weeks.
levels.promotion_message: You're a Distinguished AI Researcher now, and the paychecks are getting absurd.

levels.title: Autonomous Systems Visionary
levels.description: Your algorithms run themselves, and so, increasingly, does your calendar.
levels.promotion_message: Visionary status achieved. You barely need to show up, and yet the money keeps flowing.

levels.title: World-Renowned Machine Learning Engineer
levels.description: You show up two days a week, tweak a model or two, and casually make more before lunch than most Sims see in a lifetime.
levels.promotion_message: You are now a world-renowned ML Engineer. Take all the time off you want — you've earned every bit of it.

branches.name: Executive Leadership Track
branches.description: Stop building the algorithms and start owning the company that profits from them — ethics optional.

levels.title: Corporate Algorithm Overseer
levels.description: You stop coding and start deciding which models get deployed on an unsuspecting public.
levels.promotion_message: You're now a Corporate Algorithm Overseer. Somewhere, an ethics board just got quieter.

levels.title: Director of Global AI Domination
levels.description: You expand the company's reach into markets that definitely didn't ask for this much AI.
levels.promotion_message: Director of Global AI Domination! Your business cards are printed in a slightly menacing font now.

levels.title: Chief AI Overlord
levels.description: You sit at the head of a boardroom table, nodding along to plans you only half understand and fully approve of.
levels.promotion_message: Chief AI Overlord. You now have a personal elevator and questionable amounts of power.

levels.title: Chief Executive Officer, Supreme Overlord of Innovation
levels.description: You work three short days a week signing off on things you probably shouldn't, and the money is obscene.
levels.promotion_message: You are now CEO. Take all the time off you want — the empire runs itself, whether or not that's a good thing.
